description: Assesses every Gen1 dataflow in a workspace for in-place upgrade to Gen2.

reasons.message: The dataflow has more load-enabled queries than Dataflows Gen2 supports (50).

notes: Preview API. It always evaluates all Gen1 dataflows in the workspace; Gen2 dataflows are excluded. Status is Unknown, ReadyToMigrate, NeedsAttention, or UpgradeUnavailable. Reasons are omitted for ReadyToMigrate.
